<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2010/07/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Npc</id>
    <version>1.0.5</version>
    <authors>Ilya Margolin</authors>
    <owners>Ilya Margolin</owners>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/marhoily/npc</projectUrl>
    <description>Helps to write expressions like: 
        myViewModel.Track(vm => vm.A.B.C.Name) and be sure
        to get notified whenewer vm.A, or A.B, or C.Name changed.</description>
    <summary>Set of utilities that help to track INotifyPropertyChange, 
      DependencyProperty, ObservableCollection, etc.</summary>
    <tags>WPF MVVM reactive track observe change INotifyPropertyChange DependencyProperty ObservableCollection</tags>
  </metadata>
</package>
